subject: Post-call: GreenGrid expansion — blended rate scenarios & runway check
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sekhar Reddy <sekhar@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: GreenGrid expansion — next-step numbers we discussed

Hi Sekhar — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a clean expansion quote for your leadership and procurement team.

Highlights from our call:
- Current pilot traffic: embeddings-heavy search + a small chat assist path. You said the pilot is ~25M tokens/month today and the pilot goal is to reach ~80M tokens/month within 4–6 months if metrics hold.
- Budget target (from your side): roughly $/1M tokens around $450 (you said that’s the ballpark you’re comfortable with).
- Key asks on our side: whether you want a single blended rate across routes/models or separate rates for chat vs embeddings; and confirmation of ramp timeline and any hard budget cap requirements.

Concrete asks (can you confirm by EOD Wed?):
1) Monthly volume by route/model today (rough split: embeddings vs chat vs rerank). A CSV export is perfect.
2) Target ramp timeline (month-by-month expected volumes for next 6 months).
3) Any procurement constraints: preferred vendor contract length, PO process, and whether a pilot/PO is required before committing to reserved capacity.

Attached I’ve dropped three pricing scenarios (conservative, target, and aggressive runway) so you can see how blended and tiered approaches map to your $/1M target. High-level notes in the sheet — we can tailor further once we have the volume split.

Next steps from Redwood: Ben (cc’d) will sketch a blended-tier quote and a route-separated quote for comparison. We’ll aim to get a formal quote + a 90-day pilot canary plan to you by Friday.

Thanks —
Lauren
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

Attachment: Redwood-GreenGrid-pricing-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet; scenarios + blended calculations)
From: Sekhar Reddy <sekhar@greengrid.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@greengrid.ai, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: GreenGrid expansion — next-step numbers we discussed

Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers below so we’re aligned:

- Today’s split (approx): embeddings/search 22M tokens, chat assistants 3M tokens.
- Ramp expectation: month 1 (pilot maturation): 35M, month 2: 50M, month 3: 65M, month 4: 80M, month 5–6: 80–95M depending on customer uptake.
- Budget: We’re targeting $/1M tokens around $450 as an internal goal — procurement will push for lower, but that’s the program-level ask.
- We prefer a single blended invoiced rate if you can provide predictable blended economics across the route mix; however, we need the ability to see per-route breakdowns for internal chargebacks.
- Procurement notes: standard SOW + PO. We can do a 90-day pilot with consumption invoiced monthly and a conversion to a committed tier if pilot KPIs are met.

I attached the usage export from our pilot tools. Let me know if you want the raw logs.

Sekhar
Head of Product
GreenGrid

Attachment: GreenGrid-usage-export.csv (CSV; sample token counts by route)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: GreenGrid expansion — next-step numbers we discussed

Ben/Monica — forwarding Sekhar’s confirmation. Quick internal recommendation so we can turn around a first-pass commercial: 

Summary of ask: target ~$450/1M target from customer; ramp to ~80–95M over 4–6 months; wants a single blended invoice but visibility by route.

Commercial proposal (first pass):
- Option A (Tiered blended commit):
  • 0–50M: $520 per 1M tokens
  • 50–100M: $440 per 1M tokens
  • 100M+: $400 per 1M tokens
  => Example blended at 80M (with 22M embeddings bias) = ~ $462/1M (meets customer target range; leaves negotiation room)

- Option B (Route-weighted blended + embedding discount):
  • Base chat rate: $560/1M
  • Embeddings discount: 25% off base (effective embeddings rate $420/1M)
  • Invoice blended based on monthly route volumes; provide a per-route breakout on the bill for chargeback.

Operational guardrails to propose with either option:
- 90-day canary pilot: month-to-month invoicing; if pilot meets agreed activation KPIs, convert to a 12-month commit with the tiers above.
- Spend cap option: hard monthly cap and alerting; we can include an auto-fallback to lower-cost model variants if cap is reached.
- Quant and cached prefix recommendations from Optimize team to reduce effective token burn; include a joint tech-runbook session during pilot.

Ask for you both: please review the numbers and wiring in the attached spreadsheet. Ben — can you run a quick unit-econ calc (COGS assumptions: avg inference COGS $0.09 / 1k tokens equivalent) and highlight margin at blended points? Monica — please draft a short pilot SOW (90 days, KPIs: latency <200ms p95, error rate <0.5%, retention of cache across sessions) we can attach to the quote.

I’ll take ownership of the commercial email to Sekhar once we have Ben/Monica inputs.

Thanks —
Lauren
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sekhar Reddy <sekhar@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@greengrid.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: GreenGrid — initial quote & pilot plan (attached)

Sekhar — following up with the first formal option set based on your ramp. Attached is a short quote (GG-Quote-20270321.pdf) and the pricing scenarios workbook. Topline:

- We recommend Option A (tiered blended commit) to balance predictability and immediate savings. With your expected 80M run-rate we land at an estimated blended ~$462/1M.
- Option B (route-weighted with embeddings discount) is available if procurement needs per-route accounting; it nets to a similar blended outcome for your expected split.
- Pilot: 90 days, month-to-month invoiced. If KPIs are met we’ll convert to a 12-month commitment with the tiered pricing above.

Action items for GreenGrid:
- Confirm you’re ok with Option A vs B (reply-all with preferred option)
- Share PO timeline if procurement needs a formal quote/PO to start the pilot
- Confirm any hard monthly cap you want included in the pilot agreement

If you’re good with Option A I’ll route the quote for signature via DocuSign (link below) and we’ll schedule the technical runbook session with our Optimize team for Wednesday next week.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/track/abc123-gg-quote

Best,
Lauren
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: GG-Quote-20270321.pdf (PDF; formal quote + SOW summary)
